thread:
marta: Heads up — ops asked about gating audit export bundles for canary rollouts. want to avoid leaking actor PII during early rollouts.
sasha: yeah we had that convo last week. proposal was: exports include `actor_pseudonym` by default, full actor mapping only if tenant-level entitlement + signed request.
jordy: how do we plan to deliver the mapping? presigned link in the bundle metadata or separate encrypted artifact?
owen: separate encrypted artifact is safer. easier to rotate keys and audit access. plus we can enforce KMS unwrap in Private deployments.
kevin: worried about UX for Console -> Download: if we hide mapping behind extra auth, support will get lots of tickets. can we show a condensed "who changed X" preview without exposing identifiers?
marta: preview idea is good — show display-friendly breadcrumbs: e.g., "team: infra, role: admin" instead of user id. preview generated when export requested and cached for 24h.
sasha: also need API shape for consumers. current export manifest looks like:
```
{
  "bundle_id": "b_123",
  "ndjson_url": "https://.../bundle.ndjson",
  "actor_map_url": "https://.../actors.enc",
  "actor_map_hint": "pseudonymized",
  "signed": true
}
```
kevin: for canary we should set `actor_map_url` to null and include `actor_map_hint":"delayed-available"` so consumers know to poll.
jordy: quotas — exporting large changefeeds can blow through tenant export quotas. add `estimated_size_bytes` and precheck API that reserves quota before generating full bundle.
owen: telemetry: we must tag export bundles with `rollout_tag: canary-v2` and emit metrics `export.preview_shown`, `actor_map_requested`, `actor_map_downloaded`.
deploy-bot: canary rollout started for export-service v2 (instance x3) :rocket:
kevin: edge-case: legal hold requests may demand full actor mapping immediately. add an override flow: admin with `legal_hold` entitlement can request immediate mapping; audit log the override.
marta: agreed. implementation plan: 1) API precheck + reserve quota 2) bundle manifest change (add hint fields) 3) preview generation for console 4) encrypted actor artifact behind entitlement 5) telemetry + canary rollout. i can draft the API PR.
sasha: sounds good. small ask — add a non-repudiation signature for the actor artifact so downstream can verify provenance. `artifact_signature` field.
jordy: i'll sketch the quota reservation endpoint: `POST /exports/precheck {tenant, size_est}` -> returns `{allowed: bool, reserved_id}` and TTL for reservation.
owen: let's also include guidance in Console: show "mapping available in X hours" when canary is restricting mapping. reduces support noise.
kevin: ok ship the PR but pls include migration plan for older manifests. we should return a `compat` flag so old consumers don't break.
marta: thanks team — i'll open the PR and link this thread. if anyone wants to pair on the preview UX ping me. :thumbsup:
summary: Discussion about canary gating of actor mapping in audit export bundles: preview UX, encrypted artifact, API precheck/reserve quotas, telemetry, legal hold override, and rollout plan.
